Asset type: a complete night harbor backdrop for CosyWorld.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the finished NIGHT harbor with the ship at its berth. Input image 2 is a supporting reference showing the exact empty berth and water in daylight.
Primary request: make the matching EMPTY BERTH night painting. Remove only the merchant ship, its mast, sail, cargo, ship reflection, rigging, and the mooring ropes that lead to it. Restore the calm water and the parts of the distant shore revealed by that removal, using input 2 as the geometry reference and input 1 as the night lighting reference. Keep the exact full canvas, camera, every other object, olive leaves, quay, mooring stones, shore buildings, lamps, moon position, sky, clouds, stars, and all night lighting from input 1. Preserve the painterly style and fine detail. The finished opaque painting matches input 1 so that the harbor stays still when the game changes the ship's saved dock.

Preserve the scene's clear weather so the game can add its shared rain or mist layer. The artwork fills the whole canvas.
